themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, particularly in healthcare, housing, and welfare. This theme reflects a shared strategy to prioritize citizens over immigrants in public services, with notable implementations in Spain, Italy, and France.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox implements 'national priority' policies in healthcare and housing in regional governments, emphasizing Spanish citizens' access to services.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's right-wing coalition introduces similar policies, focusing on Italian citizens in welfare distribution.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN proposes curfews for minors and prioritizes French nationals in public services.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS emphasizes Polish citizens' priority in healthcare and social benefits.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK advocates for British citizens' priority in public services, aligning with the broader European trend.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with public exchanges over Italy's refusal to support U.S. actions against Iran and alleged requests for a G7 photo. This theme highlights the broader strain in transatlantic relations under far-right leadership.

countries.note: French far-right observes the fallout, with Bardella aligning with Meloni's stance on sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders globally, including Javier Milei and Donald Trump, have publicly celebrated the narrow victory of Colombia's far-right presidential candidate Abelardo de la Espriella. This theme underscores the transnational solidarity among far-right movements and their shared ideological alignment.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
